tha-ap192:1.1: Tivaṇṭipupphiya.] Abhibhuṃ vopanijjhanti sabbe saṅgamma te mamaṃ / tesaṃ nijjhāyamānānaṃ pariḷāho ajāyatha. // //
tha-ap192:2.1: Sunando nāma nāmena Buddhassa sāvako tadā / Dhammadassissa munino āgacchi mama santike. // // Ye
tha-ap192:3.1: me paddhacarā āsuṃ te me pupphaṃ aduṃ tadā / tāhaṃ pupphaṃ gahetvāna sāvake abhiropayiṃ. // //
tha-ap192:4.1: So haṃ kālakato tattha punāpi upapajj' ahaṃ / aṭṭhārase kappasate vinipātaṃ n' agacch' ahaṃ. // //
tha-ap192:5.1: Terase 'to kappasate aṭṭhāsuṃ Dhūmaketuno / sattaratanasampannā cakkavattī mahabbalo. // //
tha-ap192:7.1: Itthaṃ sudam āyasmā Tivaṇṭipupphiyo thero i. g. a-ti.
tha-ap192:11.1: Kuṭajo Bandhujīvī ca Koṭumbarika Hatthiyo Isimuggo ca Bodhī ca Ekacinti Tikaṇṇiko Ekacārī Tivaṇṭī ca gāthāyo bāsaṭṭhi kittitā.
